verdict.rationale: Cline Kanban is a first-party web task board for running many coding agents in parallel. Each card gets its own isolated git worktree, with auto-commit, dependency chains, and per-card diff review with inline comments, which matches managing multiple agent sessions from one workspace. The native app also runs agent sessions across folders from one place. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Kanban multi-session workflow, and detail on cross-session monitoring and status oversight.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace

citations.quote: Run many agents in parallel from a web-based task board with per-card worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains.
